authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/gamechanger/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/gamechanger/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the document's CC map, on the channel variable; an MSB row and the LSB row 32 above it are one 14-bit value, the MSB sent first. Nothing here has been sent to a real pedal yet.

The map sets the pedal's position three ways: CC 27 in 7 bits, CC 28 and 60 in 14, and the pitch wheel; and the EXP output's override value two (CC 105, CC 26 and 58). Each is laid out as printed. Its program changes (loading and saving the ten preset slots, the pitch ranges, the EXP override and more) are not laid out.
